driver_proof.custody: Producer baseline/after contain eleven named stats plus SHA for MAIN/WAL/SHM/journal; driver independently captures post-reap source DB files NOATIME/NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK and compares to that native baseline. Initial baseline is producer-recorded, not a fabricated supervisor before-fixture DB observation.
driver_proof.environment: Approved exact Python version selected by CLI, Linux/x86_64/glibc>=2.36 real virtualenv, installed total+unique157 exact policy/lock names/versions/hashsets before fixture creation.
driver_proof.imports: Producer records actual child module origins; driver validates that pinned source/stdlib/actual virtualenv graph. Supervisor itself imports stdlib only, aside from Python environment startup behavior.
driver_proof.maintenance: No additional worker/GC/restore/SQLite/pin calls. Positive rotations/ACKcompaction required by native full contract; zero GCdeleted/intent is explicitly no positive deletion proof.
driver_proof.process: New process session, native PID, actual wait4 status/user+systemCPU/lifetimeRSS/input+outputblocks/reap. Completion must be observed by wait4 strictly before the management deadline; polling cannot infer an earlier exit. Lifetime wait4 RSS must remain within the existing2GiB limit. Watchdog makes one TERM/KILL termination attempt with separately declared grace; unreaped process prevents acceptance and all postcaptures of source/index/tar/database/log.
driver_proof.progress: Only native stdout/result.json are producers. Driver reports elapsed/remain/log bytes/PID without interpreting an in-progress result as complete.
driver_proof.result: Lossless native JSON/log retained after actual reap. Green requires exact actual1202 cuts with each Source read clock joined to its cut, all flags/metadata/custody/source checks, final CURRENT clock+sequence equal the last cut, normal child exit0 observed before the management deadline, existing2GiB lifetimeRSS, no management timeout/errors and actual reap.
driver_proof.source: Independent stdlib raw Git/whole namespace and SHA/mode/blob verification before/after, original index/tar rehash, driver bytes bound to the Git member.

historical_boundary.guard2_run: The separate 3bad2/2 native physical custody guard receipt remains its own scoped execution, not full horizon or driver execution.
historical_boundary.normal4_driver: Existing d933 hardcoded300s/ticks4 original source and RAW remain untouched.
historical_boundary.normal4s_do_not_qualify: No duration extrapolation from eb17/d933 four-cut witnesses and no reinterpretation of old10stats+SHA as11.

limits: This plan and driver have only AST/compile validation; no import, native child, fixture, benchmark or horizon was executed during preparation.
Future Source S, tree, raw archive/index, interpreter and explicit management watchdog must be fixed by ROOT after all integration.
Local pinned source and producer-captured evidence do not supply external ledger/provider/market/account authenticity.
Python hooks and metadata version checks are not kernel isolation, wheel-byte authentication or an observed Docker ImageID.
Filesystem allocation/preflight and final capture have no new absolute wall deadline inferred from the native30s gate or the child management watchdog.
A local horizon green remains separate from finalGov/FIP/browser/build/image/primary/runtime approval.

management_cli.scope: Watchdog applies to child supervision through observed wait4 completion. Native30s postPRE full-cycle gate remains unchanged. Preflight/capture/file IO and final custody/receipt emission are outside this child-management timer; signal/reap cannot guarantee kernel I/O latency. native_completion_observation_elapsed_seconds is the child-supervision clock; supervisor_elapsed_before_final_custody_seconds is explicitly partial and excludes the final Source/log/proof/receipt tail.
management_cli.watchdog: Explicit finite positive caller value; no default borrowed from the historical300s NORMAL4 wrapper.

namespaces.data: Inexistent private native fixture root with existing canonical parent, separate from raw/whole/repo. Profile creates data/data/paper_v17/observer_v17.db.
namespaces.git: Local raw Git commit/tree/blob authority with no replacement refs or lazy fetch; HEAD may later advance while S objects remain immutable.
namespaces.prepared: Existing source.index.json and adjacent original source.tar. This is separate from new raw-root.
namespaces.raw: Inexistent output directory with existing canonical parent; source/index/native result copies retained losslessly there.
namespaces.whole: Exact full Git archive of S, with all SHA/modes/blobIDs and no overlays/empty dirs/aliases.

native_contract.business_source: Fixed synthetic SourceDB; intraday must become unverified after native AT+120s. No data refresh/rewrite/injected marks/entryauthority.
native_contract.phases: Native nonempty phase values are preserved; no continuous OPEN requirement or real PPI session authority is manufactured.

ownership.scope: Only this new external .py.source driver and its source plan; no ROOT/product/profile edits.

source_driver.authority: Future Source S must contain this exact .py.source member; external executed bytes are checked against its wholeSource Git binding before fixtures.

source_review_corrections.finding: Late polling could reap a child after the management deadline while leaving the timeout flag false.
source_review_corrections.fix: Timestamp after wait4 must be strictly before the deadline; later observation remains NOT_ACCEPTED even if normal exit0. The driver never claims an actual exit timestamp from wait4.

source_review_corrections.finding: Final custody could read source/index/tar/log after termination failed to reap the child.
source_review_corrections.fix: Unreaped state skips all postcaptures, records the unobserved custody limit and prevents acceptance; termination is not retried with a fresh grace.

source_review_corrections.finding: A verified final archive HEAD did not independently bind final CURRENT to the last cut.
source_review_corrections.fix: Require producer final_as_of and final_sequence to match cuts[-1].

source_review_corrections.finding: Native RSS was captured before its final JSON serialization.
source_review_corrections.fix: Require actual wait4 lifetime peak_rss_bytes to satisfy the same existing2GiB limit after reap.

source_review_corrections.finding: Source read clocks were not bound to corresponding actual native cuts, so a fixed read clock could preserve apparent freshness at late cuts.
source_review_corrections.fix: Strictly join all1202 Source reads to cuts/clocks by index and as_of; derive staleness from each actual cut clock.

source_review_corrections.finding: The management_elapsed_wall_seconds field excluded the final Source/log/proof/receipt tail.
source_review_corrections.fix: Rename to supervisor_elapsed_before_final_custody_seconds and explicitly declare the partial scope; retain observed child completion as a separate clock without adding a new deadline.
